findings.title: BRANCH_PROTECTION.md runbook lists a stale required-check set
findings.impact: An operator applying the runbook manually would omit the supply-chain required check, re-opening the gap fixed for CI-P2-001.
findings.recommendation: Update the runbook's required-check list (or make it reference the policy file as the single source).

findings.title: Live branch protection not verified in this read-only pass
evidence: scripts/verify-branch-protection.mjs falls back to self-test without a token
findings.impact: Repository policy is proven consistent; the live GitHub setting remains unverified evidence (as the runbook itself states).
findings.recommendation: Run the live audit with an admin token and store the raw PASS output under evidence/.

report: Declared policy (.github/branch-protection.json) requires foundation, migrations, e2e and license-and-vulnerability, strict, code-owner review, conversation resolution, and no force-push/delete. The self-test passed on the lab: 'PASS policy is complete and matches workflow jobs'. Residual: the operator runbook still lists only three checks, and live protection cannot be verified without an admin token.
